svg.title: Three-tenant legal-finance architecture and live gates
svg.desc: Provider synthetic Bronze flows through Silver into separate Harbor and Kestrel Gold lakehouses. Manual external shares lead to separate consumer tenants. Security blocks live ontology binding; agent binding and M365 Word verification remain separate gates. No customer-residency or completed live deployment is claimed.
